incident-bot: ALERT  Severity=P1  Real-time p99 latency anomaly detected on hosted-api-prod: p99 > 5s in ap-southeast-1 and us-east-1 (streaming routes)  
zoe (sre): Acknowledged. Paging oncall. Any recent control-plane changes?  
priya (infra): No infra deploys in last hour. Noted a spike in LB 502s earlier but it recovered.  
cal (eng-runtime): I'm seeing unusual backpressure in the runtime connection pool and a surge of stalled chunks for streaming sessions. Pulling logs now.  
zoe (sre): Quick triage: 1) confirm affected customers/routes 2) check streaming queue depth 3) check runtime kv cache and connection pool metrics 4) consider routing overrides  
tom (ops): Dash: https://console/redwood/alerts/1716001234  p95 ~1.1s, p99 ~5.6s, streaming stall count +4.2x  
cal (eng-runtime): Logs show repeated `connection_acquire_timeout` and `kv_eviction_pressure` events. Example:  
```
2026-03-15T09:00:41Z runtime.warn connection_acquire_timeout session=abcd123 region=ap-southeast-1
2026-03-15T09:00:43Z runtime.error kv_eviction_pressure model=gptx-13b context_kv_bytes=120MB
```
  
zoe (sre): Are these tied to a particular model or context length?  
cal (eng-runtime): Mostly requests with >8k tokens contexts hitting `gptx-13b-ff` and `gptx-70b-ff`. The eviction pressure suggests working set exceeds configured per-shard KV capacity.  
megan (product): Any customer impact? Which tenants hit that route?  
kira (customer-success): Two enterprise tenants on ap-southeast-1 dedicated pools reporting timeouts. I've DM'd account owners.  
priya (infra): I can spin up a few extra nodes in ap-southeast-1 but that won't solve hotspotting if KV is unevenly sharded.  
cal (eng-runtime): Short-term mitigation options: 1) reduce per-request allowed context window for streaming to 4k tokens for affected routes 2) route streaming to low-KV quantized variants 3) temporarily increase per-shard KV capacity via config override  
zoe (sre): Which option is fastest with minimal risk?  
cal (eng-runtime): Routing to quantized variant is low-risk and quick. Reducing context window requires client-side coordination; infra config change is medium risk.  
megan (product): Approve routing fallback for streaming routes for 20 minutes. Notify impacted customers.  
priya (infra): I'll do a 15% canary change for routing via control plane now:  
```
curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/route/override -d '{"scope":"streaming","target_variant":"gptx-13b-quant","pct":15,"ttl":"20m"}'
```
  
incident-bot: ACTION  priya (infra) applied routing override at 1716001290  pct=15  
priya (infra): Canary live. Monitoring latency for canary subset.  
zoe (sre): Can we add output diffs sampling for correctness checks?  
cal (eng-runtime): Enabled 5% diff sampling between primary and fallback variants for streaming requests. No high-sev diffs in first 2 mins.  
priya (infra): Canary p99 for canary subset down to ~1.6s, overall p99 still ~4.2s (because fallback not yet broad).  
tom (ops): Metrics stable for 90s, increasing to 50% now.  
incident-bot: ACTION  priya (infra) updated routing override at 1716001380  pct=50  
zoe (sre): After canary expansion p95 ~900ms, p99 ~1.7s for streaming. Stalls reduced by ~80%.  
kira (customer-success): Sending status update to impacted customers: "We've implemented temporary routing to a lower-memory variant to mitigate streaming stalls. We're monitoring and will follow up with root cause/postmortem."  
cal (eng-runtime): While the fallback is in place, I'll gather heap and KV-shard metrics and validate shard affinity. There might be an autoscaler-induced uneven distribution for high-traffic tenants.  
megan (product): Also confirm there's no semantic degradation for sampled outputs.  
cal (eng-runtime): Diff sampling shows minor tokenization differences; no semantic drift for the sample.  
zoe (sre): Next steps: 1) observe for 20m with routing in place 2) collect traces and GC/connection-pool metrics 3) prepare incident ticket and postmortem owner  
priya (infra): I'll investigate node affinity and autoscaler logs to see if certain shards got overloaded after a recent affinity tweak.  
cal (eng-runtime): I'll open a small runtime tuning change to increase KV eviction threshold and reduce connection acquire timeout to avoid long waits — deploy to small runtime subset for validation.  
zoe (sre): Keep change rollout <10% initially.  
priya (infra): No further 502s in last 5m, LB health checks OK.  
kira (customer-success): Customers acknowledged the mitigation message and are monitoring.  
zoe (sre): If stable at end of TTL we rollback routing override and schedule postmortem. If regressions appear, call full paging.  
priya (infra): Routing override auto-expires at 1716002450 unless we extend.  
zoe (sre): Oncall handoff: I'll keep monitoring for 25 more minutes, then hand to eng-runtime for RCA and follow-ups. Thanks team :thumbsup:  
incident-bot: UPDATE  mitigation -> monitoring  live mitigation started at 1716001290  
cal (eng-runtime): Opening incident ticket IR-2026-171600 with notes and links to traces. Assign to eng-runtime and infra for RCA.  
zoe (sre): Closing live paging but keeping channel open for monitoring window. If anything worsens, page immediate rotation.  
incident-bot: CLOSED-LIVE  mitigated -> monitoring at 1716002000
